$ ergon init --help
Usage: ergon init <command> [options]

Set up a repository with the baseline of ergon.

ergon init sets up a repository with the baseline of ergon. The baseline
consists of the common files, the GitHub files and the license files of every
repository, and the files of each language of the repository. ergon init
records its answers, the baseline value of each option and the digest of each
managed file in .ergon/init.lock. Commit the lock with the files.

ergon init treats a file by its class:

  - A managed file is the rendering of ergon. ergon init check reports a
    managed file that differs from the rendering. To add a setting of the
    repository to the managed file at a path, write the setting to the same
    path under .ergon/local. ergon merges that local file into the rendering.
  - A seeded file, such as README.md, is written when it is absent. The
    repository maintains it from then on.
  - ergon init writes the keys of its answers into .ergon.yaml, and a section
    for each language with options, such as the versions of its tools. The
    repository changes an option there, and ergon init renders the managed
    files from it. The flags of ergon init sync change the key of an answer,
    such as license.spdx, and every command fails while such a key differs
    from the lock. ergon init keeps every other key.

Commands:
  new      Write the baseline into a repository without a lock.
  add      Add languages to the repository.
  remove   Remove languages from the repository.
  check    Report the managed files that differ from the baseline.
  sync     Bring the managed files to the baseline of this ergon.
  upgrade  Move the repository to the baseline of the newest release of ergon.
  ci       Run the job of the workflow baseline.yml.

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env ERGON_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
      --version     Show the version.
[exit 0]

$ ergon init
Usage: ergon init <command> [options]

Set up a repository with the baseline of ergon.

ergon init sets up a repository with the baseline of ergon. The baseline
consists of the common files, the GitHub files and the license files of every
repository, and the files of each language of the repository. ergon init
records its answers, the baseline value of each option and the digest of each
managed file in .ergon/init.lock. Commit the lock with the files.

ergon init treats a file by its class:

  - A managed file is the rendering of ergon. ergon init check reports a

  - ergon init writes the keys of its answers into .ergon.yaml, and a section
    for each language with options, such as the versions of its tools. The

  check    Report the managed files that differ from the baseline.
  sync     Bring the managed files to the baseline of this ergon.

  ci       Run the job of the workflow baseline.yml.

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env ERGON_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
      --version     Show the version.

ergon: init: missing command
[exit 2]

$ ergon init new --help
Usage: ergon init new [options]

Write the baseline into a repository without a lock.

ergon init new writes the baseline into a repository that has no lock: the
managed files, the seeded files that are absent, the keys and the options of
.ergon.yaml, and .ergon/init.lock. It prints the path of each file that it
writes.

When a managed file exists with other content, the command fails and does not
write a file. With --force, it overwrites such a file.

--licensed-work, --additional-use-grant, --change-date and --change-license
set the parameters of BUSL-1.1 in .ergon.yaml, and need --license BUSL-1.1.
A parameter may be empty. Its line of LICENSE then has its label alone.

--name defaults to the name of the working directory, and --year to the
current year. The languages are:

  alpha, beta

Example:
  ergon init new --language go --owner "Example B.V." --license MIT \
    --repository example/demo --security-contact security@example.com

Options:
      --additional-use-grant string  Additional Use Grant of BUSL-1.1, such as None.                  env ERGON_INIT_NEW_ADDITIONAL_USE_GRANT
      --change-date string           Change Date of BUSL-1.1, such as 2030-01-01.                     env ERGON_INIT_NEW_CHANGE_DATE
      --change-license string        Change License of BUSL-1.1, such as GPL-2.0-or-later.            env ERGON_INIT_NEW_CHANGE_LICENSE
      --force                        Overwrite the managed files that exist with other content.       env ERGON_INIT_NEW_FORCE
      --language language,...        Language of the repository, once for each language.              env ERGON_INIT_NEW_LANGUAGE
      --license id                   License, as an SPDX identifier that ergon license --help lists.  required, env ERGON_INIT_NEW_LICENSE
      --licensed-work string         Licensed Work of BUSL-1.1, such as "Example 1.0".                env ERGON_INIT_NEW_LICENSED_WORK
      --name string                  Name of the repository.                                          env ERGON_INIT_NEW_NAME
      --owner string                 Copyright holder, such as "Example B.V.".                        required, env ERGON_INIT_NEW_OWNER
      --repository repository        Repository on GitHub, as owner/name.                             required, env ERGON_INIT_NEW_REPOSITORY
      --security-contact string      Address that receives reports of vulnerabilities.                required, env ERGON_INIT_NEW_SECURITY_CONTACT
      --year int                     Year of the copyright notice.                                    env ERGON_INIT_NEW_YEAR

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env ERGON_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
      --version     Show the version.
[exit 0]

$ ergon init add --help
Usage: ergon init add [options] LANGUAGE...

Add languages to the repository.

ergon init add adds languages to the answers of .ergon/init.lock. It writes
the files of each language, its fragments of the shared files and its section
of .ergon.yaml. It prints the path of each file that it writes.

When a file that the command changes was edited by hand, the command fails and
does not write a file. With --force, it overwrites such a file.

Example:
  ergon init add typescript

Arguments:
      LANGUAGE  Language of the repository.

Options:
      --force  Overwrite the managed files that were edited by hand.  env ERGON_INIT_ADD_FORCE

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env ERGON_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
      --version     Show the version.
[exit 0]

$ ergon init remove --help
Usage: ergon init remove [options] LANGUAGE...

Remove languages from the repository.

ergon init remove removes languages from the answers of .ergon/init.lock. It
removes the files of each language and its section of .ergon.yaml, and
rewrites the shared files. It prints the path of each file that it writes or
removes.

When a file that the command changes or removes was edited by hand, the
command fails and does not change a file. Move the edit into the local file of
the path, and run ergon init sync --force first.

Example:
  ergon init remove typescript

Arguments:
      LANGUAGE  Language of the repository.

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env ERGON_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
      --version     Show the version.
[exit 0]

$ ergon init check --help
Usage: ergon init check [options]

Report the managed files that differ from the baseline.

ergon init check compares the managed files with the rendering of this ergon
for the answers of .ergon/init.lock and the options of .ergon.yaml. It does
not write a file. It prints the problem and the path of each managed file that
is missing, edited by hand or outdated. The exit status is 1 when it prints a
file, and when .ergon.yaml has an option that its section does not accept.

Example:
  ergon init check --json

Options:
      --json  Write the findings as a JSON array.  env ERGON_INIT_CHECK_JSON

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env ERGON_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
      --version     Show the version.
[exit 0]

$ ergon init sync --help
Usage: ergon init sync [options]

Bring the managed files to the baseline of this ergon.

ergon init sync brings the managed files to the rendering of this ergon. It
writes each missing and outdated file and .ergon/init.lock, and removes each
file that the rendering no longer contains. It prints the path of each file
that it writes or removes.

A flag of ergon init sync changes its answer in the lock. An answer without a
flag keeps its value. An option of .ergon.yaml that still has the baseline
value of the lock moves to the baseline value of this ergon, and an option
that the repository changed keeps its value.

The command does not change a file that was edited by hand. It writes every
other file, and then exits with the status 1. With --force, it overwrites such
a file.

Example:
  ergon init sync --owner "Example B.V."

Options:
      --force                    Overwrite the managed files that were edited by hand.            env ERGON_INIT_SYNC_FORCE
      --license id               License, as an SPDX identifier that ergon license --help lists.  env ERGON_INIT_SYNC_LICENSE
      --name string              Name of the repository.                                          env ERGON_INIT_SYNC_NAME
      --owner string             Copyright holder, such as "Example B.V.".                        env ERGON_INIT_SYNC_OWNER
      --repository repository    Repository on GitHub, as owner/name.                             env ERGON_INIT_SYNC_REPOSITORY
      --security-contact string  Address that receives reports of vulnerabilities.                env ERGON_INIT_SYNC_SECURITY_CONTACT
      --year int                 Year of the copyright notice.                                    env ERGON_INIT_SYNC_YEAR

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env ERGON_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
      --version     Show the version.
[exit 0]

$ ergon init bogus
ergon: init: unknown command "bogus"
[exit 2]

$ ergon init new --year next --owner 'Example B.V.' --license MIT --repository example/demo --security-contact security@example.com
ergon: init new: invalid --year "next" from flag --year: invalid syntax
[exit 2]

$ ergon init new --license MIT --repository example/demo --security-contact security@example.com
ergon: init new: missing --owner
[exit 2]

$ ergon init new --owner 'Example B.V.' --repository example/demo --security-contact security@example.com
ergon: init new: missing --license
[exit 2]

$ ergon init new --owner 'Example B.V.' --license MIT --security-contact security@example.com
ergon: init new: missing --repository
[exit 2]

$ ergon init new --owner 'Example B.V.' --license MIT --repository example/demo
ergon: init new: missing --security-contact
[exit 2]

$ ergon init new --change-date 2030-01-01 --owner 'Example B.V.' --license MIT --repository example/demo --security-contact security@example.com
ergon: cli: --change-date sets a parameter of BUSL-1.1 and needs --license BUSL-1.1
[exit 2]

$ ergon init add
ergon: init add: missing argument LANGUAGE
[exit 2]

$ ergon init remove
ergon: init remove: missing argument LANGUAGE
[exit 2]

$ ergon init remove --force alpha
ergon: init remove: unknown flag --force
[exit 2]
